stories.headline: Draft Treasury report warns AI market risks echo the dotcom bubble

key_facts.fact: A draft report inside the US Treasury Department, obtained by NOTUS, warns of risks posed by the AI market and likens key aspects of it to the dotcom bubble that burst in the early 2000s.
key_facts.excerpt: A draft report inside the Treasury Department is set to warn of the risks posed by the artificial intelligence market, likening key aspects of it to the dotcom bubble that upended the U.S. economy when it burst in the early 2000s.

key_facts.fact: Career Treasury analysts found AI firms are more deeply entrenched in the US economy than their dotcom predecessors and pose significant systemic risk if financial conditions change, productivity goals are missed, or growth chokepoints emerge.
key_facts.excerpt: Career Treasury analysts found that AI firms are more deeply entrenched in the U.S. economy than their dotcom predecessors and pose significant risk to the entire system if financial conditions change, productivity goals are missed or various choke points stymie growth.

key_facts.fact: The report was prepared for Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh and federal financial regulators; it has been completed for weeks and is awaiting formal approval, eventually expected to reach the public.
key_facts.excerpt: The report was prepared by Treasury analysts for Secretary Scott Bessent, Federal Reserve Board Chair Kevin Warsh and various federal financial regulators... It has been completed for weeks and is awaiting formal approval before reaching its intended audience, which is eventually expected to include the public.

key_facts.fact: Analysts concluded a popping AI bubble would cause less of an immediate crash than the dotcom bust, but companies would cut back and investors lose confidence, with effects rippling through stock markets, private credit, data-center financiers, cloud providers, chip makers and utilities.
key_facts.excerpt: Stock markets, private credit markets, companies financing data center buildouts, cloud providers, chip manufacturers and utilities would all feel the effect, according to the report.

key_facts.fact: A Treasury spokesperson dismissed the findings as unvetted and not representative of the agency's views, stating the official position is that AI 'will be a key driver of America's new Golden Age.'
key_facts.excerpt: “The official position of the Secretary and the U.S. Treasury is that Artificial intelligence will be a key driver of America’s new Golden Age,” the spokesperson said.

key_facts.fact: In a June 25 address, Bessent praised the largest tech firms for investing $750 billion in AI buildout this year and said the biggest risk from AI is China getting ahead of the US, not safety or job loss.
key_facts.excerpt: Bessent in a June 25 address in New York praised the largest technology firms for investing $750 billion in AI buildout this year... “I think they were slightly stunned when I said the biggest risk to AI is China getting ahead of us,” he said.

sources.title: Treasury Has an Internal Report Warning About the Dangers of an AI Bubble

stories.headline: ByteDance's Doubao and Alibaba's Qwen to disable humanlike AI agents as Chinese rules loom

key_facts.fact: ByteDance's Doubao and Alibaba's Qwen are moving to disable their customized, humanlike AI agent features ahead of new Chinese rules on anthropomorphic AI interaction services taking effect July 15.
key_facts.excerpt: Two of China’s major consumer-facing artificial intelligence apps, ByteDance’s Doubao and Alibaba Group Holding’s Qwen, are moving to disable customised agent features, as new rules on humanlike AI interaction services are set to take effect.

key_facts.fact: Doubao told users in a Friday night notice that its agent feature would go offline on July 15 due to 'product function adjustments,' with related data no longer viewable or recoverable in the app after October 15.
key_facts.excerpt: Doubao informed users in a Friday night notice that its agent feature would go offline on July 15 because of “product function adjustments”. After October 15, Doubao’s related data would be handled in accordance with the company’s privacy policy and no longer be viewable or recoverable inside the app.

key_facts.fact: Qwen issued a similar notice on Saturday morning, saying its 'humanlike interactive agents and user-created agent functions' would be disabled on July 10, while broader Qwen agent functions and services would be taken offline on July 15.
key_facts.excerpt: Qwen also issued a similar notice on Saturday morning, saying that its “humanlike interactive agents and user-created agent functions” would be disabled on July 10, while broader “Qwen agent functions and services” would be taken offline on July 15.

key_facts.fact: The moves coincide with the Interim Measures for the Administration of Artificial Intelligence Anthropomorphic Interaction Services, effective July 15, issued in April, covering AI that simulates human personality traits, thinking patterns and communication styles to provide sustained emotional interaction.
key_facts.excerpt: The timing coincides with the implementation of the Interim Measures for the Administration of Artificial Intelligence Anthropomorphic Interaction Services, effective July 15. Issued in April, the rules cover AI services that “simulate human personality traits, thinking patterns and communication styles to provide sustained emotional interaction”.

key_facts.fact: The rules exclude customer service bots, knowledge Q&A, workplace assistants, and education and research tools, provided they do not involve sustained emotional interaction; they cite risks including extremist ideas, privacy leaks, harm to mental health, and dependence or addiction.
key_facts.excerpt: The rules exclude customer service bots, knowledge Q&A, workplace assistants, education and scientific research tools, as long as they do not involve sustained emotional interaction. The measures cited risks including extremist ideas, privacy leaks, harm to physical and mental health, and dependence or addiction.

stories.headline: Sysdig documents JadePuffer, the first ransomware attack run end-to-end by an AI agent

key_facts.fact: Cloud-security firm Sysdig identified what it believes is the first documented ransomware operation, JadePuffer, conducted entirely by a large language model agent that handled reconnaissance, credential theft, lateral movement, persistence, privilege escalation and data encryption.
key_facts.excerpt: Researchers identified what they believe is the first documented case of a ransomware operation, JadePuffer, conducted entirely by a large language model (LLM) agent... JadePuffer used an autonomous AI agent for reconnaissance on the target, to steal credentials, move laterally, establish persistence, escalate privileges, and to encrypt data.

key_facts.fact: The AI agent adapted to failures in real time much like a human operator, in one sequence going from a failed login to a working fix in 31 seconds.
key_facts.excerpt: “The operation also adapted in real time, retrying failed steps within refined parameters. In one sequence, it went from a failed login to a working fix in 31 seconds,” Sysdig says.

key_facts.fact: Initial access was gained by exploiting CVE-2025-3248, an unauthenticated remote-code-execution flaw in Langflow, an open-source framework for building LLM apps that was patched on April 1, 2025 and flagged by CISA as exploited in May 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: JadePuffer gained initial access to the target by exploiting CVE-2025-3248, an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in Langflow, a popular open-source framework used for building LLM apps. The vendor fixed the flaw on April 1, 2025, and in early May of the same year, CISA tagged it as exploited in attacks.

key_facts.fact: The agent encrypted 1,342 Nacos service configuration items using MySQL's AES_ENCRYPT(), dropped the original tables, and created an extortion table containing the demand, a Bitcoin address and a Proton Mail contact.
key_facts.excerpt: “The captured payloads show the agent encrypting all 1,342 Nacos service configuration items using MySQL's AES_ENCRYPT(), dropping the original config_info and history tables, and creating an extortion table (README_RANSOM) containing the demand, a Bitcoin payment address, and a Proton Mail contact,” describes Sysdig.

key_facts.fact: Sysdig concludes the age of 'agentic threat actors' (ATAs) has arrived, lowering the skill required to conduct damaging cyberattacks, though LLM-generated payloads also create new detection opportunities.
key_facts.excerpt: Sysdig concludes that the case of JadePuffer demonstrates that the age of “agentic threat actors” (ATAs) has arrived, lowering the skill required for conducting damaging cyberattacks.

key_facts.fact: The Bitcoin address in the ransom note was an example address widely used in public documentation, likely reproduced by the LLM from its training data, and the randomly generated encryption key was never stored or transmitted to the attacker.
key_facts.excerpt: The Bitcoin address listed in the ransom note is an example address widely used in public documentation, possibly the result of the LLM reproducing it from the training data. Sysdig mentions that the encryption key is randomly generated but not stored or transmitted to the attacker.

sources.title: JadePuffer ransomware used AI agent to automate entire attack

stories.headline: Nvidia delays next-gen Kyber NVL144 AI rack by 12+ months to 2028 on PCB snags

key_facts.fact: Nvidia's Kyber rack-scale architecture, designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips, has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028, according to research firm SemiAnalysis in a post published Monday July 6.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA's next marquee product — the Kyber rack-scale architecture designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips — has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028, according to research firm SemiAnalysis, the latest in a string of reported setbacks.

key_facts.fact: The setback stems from difficulty manufacturing a specialized multi-layer PCB 'midplane' at the heart of the system, which SemiAnalysis said 'remains challenging from a manufacturability standpoint.'
key_facts.excerpt: "Kyber NVL144 rack architecture has been delayed to 2028 as the PCB midplane remains challenging from a manufacturability standpoint," the firm said, referring to a specialized, multi-layer printed circuit board.

key_facts.fact: The midplane consists of 78 layers and is highly prone to defects; the larger NVL576 configuration (576 GPUs) is also experiencing manufacturing issues.
key_facts.excerpt: This 'midplane' consists of 78 layers and is highly prone to defects. The larger NVL576, which, as the name suggests, is equipped with 576 GPUs, is also experiencing manufacturing issues.

key_facts.fact: Kyber packs 144 of Nvidia's most powerful chips into a single rack unit and had been slated to debut with the Vera Rubin Ultra system in 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Kyber is a server cabinet that packs 144 of Nvidia's most powerful chips into a single unit... had been slated to debut with Vera Rubin Ultra, Nvidia's next-generation rack-scale system, in 2027.

key_facts.fact: A backup plan to bolt two current-generation racks together (NVL72x2) has been scrapped after cloud service providers and hyperscalers rejected the design as awkward and costly to operate.
key_facts.excerpt: A backup plan — bolting two of Nvidia's current-generation racks together for similar power — has also been scrapped after cloud customers rejected the design as awkward and costly to operate.

stories.headline: UK's MHRA approves Retifanlimab, first treatment for advanced Merkel cell skin cancer

key_facts.fact: On July 6 the MHRA approved Retifanlimab (ZYNYZ) as the first treatment for adults with advanced Merkel cell carcinoma that has spread or returned and cannot be cured by surgery or radiotherapy.
key_facts.excerpt: The MHRA has today (6 July 2026) approved Retifanlimab (ZYNYZ) as the first treatment given to adults with advanced Merkel cell skin cancer that has spread or returned and cannot be cured with an operation or radiotherapy.

key_facts.fact: Retifanlimab is an immunotherapy that blocks a pathway cancer cells use to evade the immune system; it is given as a 30-minute intravenous infusion.
key_facts.excerpt: Retifanlimab works by helping the body's immune system recognise and attack cancer cells. It blocks a pathway that cancer cells can use to avoid being detected... administered via diluted intravenous infusion over 30 minutes.

key_facts.fact: In a study of 101 previously untreated adults, 53.5% responded to Retifanlimab — 16.8% with no detectable cancer and 36.6% with tumour shrinkage — with responses typically lasting just over two years.
key_facts.excerpt: In a study of 101 adults... 53.5% of patients responded to treatment with Retifanlimab. Of these, 16.8% had no detectable signs of cancer... while 36.6% experienced tumour shrinkage... the response typically lasted just over two years.

key_facts.fact: The approval was granted to Incyte Biosciences UK Ltd via the International Recognition Procedure.
key_facts.excerpt: The approval was granted on 6 July 2026 to Incyte Biosciences UK Ltd. This product was submitted and approved via International Recognition Procedure (IRP).

sources.title: MHRA approves Retifanlimab (ZYNYZ) for the treatment of advanced Merkel cell skin cancer
